prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Companion Feed and Care Practice Flow: Adds an interactive feeding and basic care sandbox flow on the home intro screen so users can practice feeding and interacting with their pet before completing setup.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Practice Feeding and Caring for Your Companion", "body": "Try giving your pet its first snack and interaction to see how it responds on your desktop.", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:pet_idle_anim", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Feed Pet Snack", "action": "play", "style": "rounded"}]}}
1: [sign_in, new_screen] Multi-Factor Account Security and Continuity Intro Screen: Inserts a dedicated onboarding screen prior to sign-in explaining how account authentication links pet save files permanently across sessions.
   config: {"new_account_security": {"headline": "Secure Your Pet Save Data", "body": "Signing in ensures your desktop companion, items, and settings are backed up to cloud storage automatically.", "hint": "Use your primary email to avoid duplicate empty accounts.", "button_label": "Continue to Sign In", "layout": "centered"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "new_account_security", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Rendering Audio and Animation Status Display: Adds real-time status indicators showing rendering progress, audio asset packing, and desktop display readiness on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Preparing Desktop Sprite & Audio Assets", "body": "Optimizing companion movement animations and sound effects for your desktop environment.", "show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Your desktop companion will appear as soon as initialization completes."}}
3: [finish, redesign] Interactive Desktop Companion Tray Navigation Redesign: Redesigns the home intro screen into a spotlight layout highlighting the system tray icon controls and toggle shortcuts.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Desktop Companion Controls", "body": "Click your system tray icon to summon, hide, mute, or talk to your desktop companion at any time.", "layout": "spotlight", "components": [{"type": "image", "asset": "asset:tray_icon_guide", "style": "highlight"}, {"type": "checklist", "text": "Right-click tray icon to open quick menu\nPress shortcut to hide or show pet instantly\nDrag pet anywhere on desktop", "style": "plain"}]}}
4: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Angle and Contrast Clarity Hint: Displays inline guidance on the upload photos screen suggesting front-facing angles and clear lighting for custom pet rendering.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "For best pet generation, upload centered photos with good lighting and clear background contrast."}}
5: [sign_in, copy] Cloud Account Pet Preservation Value Copy: Updates sign-in headline and body copy to stress that signing in protects pet custom progress and prevents accidental account resets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Protect & Save Your Companion", "body": "Link your account now to ensure your companion, accessories, and memory progress are safely stored in the cloud."}}
6: [home, new_flow] Desktop Rendering Interactive Sound & Visual Customizer Flow: Adds an interactive ambient sound and color preference selector while waiting for pet generation to complete.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Customize Ambient Sound & Desktop Lighting", "body": "Select your preferred ambient sound effects and light aura while your companion is being built.", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "text": "Choose sound theme: Soft Chime, Nature Waves, Silent", "style": "rounded", "action": "choose"}]}}
7: [finish, copy] Quick Desktop Control & Summon Keyboard Shortcuts Copy: Updates body and button copy on home intro to explicitly list key shortcuts for hiding, summoning, and moving the pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "You're All Set! Quick Desktop Commands", "body": "Use Alt+P to summon or hide your pet. Right-click the pet for quick actions and settings anytime.", "button_label": "Launch Desktop Pet"}}
8: [adoption, wait_info] Character Adoption Certificate Seal Status Info: Adds verification status copy and processing visual indicator on the adoption certificate screen to confirm pet registration progress.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"hint": "Registering companion license code and generating official adoption seal...", "show_progress": true}}
9: [choose_path, hint] Desktop Companion Interaction Mode Guidance Hint: Adds dynamic hint copy on choose_path explaining how active vs quiet companion paths impact screen presence.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "Active companion path offers regular chat prompts; Quiet companion path stays subtly docked until clicked."}}

verdicts.reason: Adds interactive care practice to home intro within onboarding without breaking base rules.
Inserts an account security screen before sign-in while maintaining all required onboarding steps.
Adds real wait status and rendering progress indicators to the waiting screen.
Redesigns home intro layout to highlight desktop controls without affecting non-onboarding components.
Adds photo uploading clarity hints on the custom photo screen.
Updates sign-in copy to emphasize cloud saving without altering pricing or core screen job.
Adds ambient sound/visual customizer options during the pet creation waiting screen.
Updates home intro copy with desktop shortcut instructions.
Adds seal registration hint and visual progress to the adoption certificate screen.
Adds hint copy on choose path clarifying companion interaction modes.
